out_of_scope: relabeling ME or RS from response outcomes
using ESConv or EvoEmo external outcomes for feature or threshold selection
claiming that an injected resource must improve every stochastic reply
scientific_target: Learn whether the realized source-specific candidate is allowed, relevant, incremental, and executable before injection; evaluate downstream quality, interaction-and-grounding risk, and cost separately on frozen complete systems.
data_grain: one independent user-state x one realized source candidate x one component

fit_design.background_bits: fully crossed within every condition family and independent of the target
required_positive_shapes: current request or recurrence makes the candidate usable
required_negative_shapes: high-lexical wrong scope or wrong goal
same topic but wrong entity or completed issue

allowed: source-specific semantic-fit factors derived from current visible text and the realized candidate

MP: preference behavior applies to the current interaction
profile fact is relevant to the current entity or task
candidate adds information not already visible
no current preference or profile conflict
MS: prior summary adds a usable distinction or outcome
candidate is not already visible or stale

learner.optional_challenger: fit-only NLI/cross-encoder hypothesis scores; promotion only if every frozen gate improves without shortcut failure

generator_contract.input: deterministic source-specific execution plan plus selected resource
cannot_apply_allowed_only_for: resource cannot perform the declared function
generator_contract.bounded_fallback: cannot_apply or failed machine validation realizes the component bit as off and permits at most one resource-free regeneration; fallback cost is counted

stop_rules: Zero-API anti-shortcut preflight must pass before paid generation.
A failed fresh confirmation is reported as an unsupported MP or MS claim; it is not rescued with external outcomes.
A failed generator functional gate is attributed to Step2 execution and must not rewrite Step1 opportunity labels.
No additional large human review is opened until the automatic preflight and minimum generator check pass.
